name: Apollo Pipes Limited
summary: Apollo Pipes Limited manufactures and trades in polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes and fittings in India. The company offers cPVC, uPVC, and PPR-C plumbing systems; uPVC pressure pipes and fittings, and garden pipes; HDPE PLB duct pipes and MDPE and HDPE gas piping system; SWR drainage system, underground drainage system, and DWC pipes; and agri pipes and fitting, HDPE pipes, coils, and sprinkler systems. It also provides underground drainage uPVC column Pipes, and casing pipes; water tanks, solvent cement, and kitchen sink.
